z-m-21-01.title: Mhedziso "imwe chete": i imwe chete chaizvo here?
z-m-21-01.topic: Kunyora mutsara we degree-4 semuwanzo wemitsara miviri ye quadratic: kutarisa zviitiko zvese zvinogoneka
z-m-21-01.goal: Tarisa mhedziso "imwe chete" yakawanikwa mushure mekutarisa zvimwe zvezviitiko zvinogoneka chete, gadzira zvigadzirwa zvakasiyana zvemitsara ye quadratic zvemutsara mumwechete we degree-4 kuti usimbise, uye utsanangure kuti nei nhamba yenzira yakagadzwa kunyangwe mamiriro akawedzerwa.
z-m-21-01.material: Jiho akawana nzira yekunyora x⁴−5x²+4 muchimiro che (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d). Pano coefficient ye x² i 1 mumitsara miviri yese ye quadratic, a, b, c, d i integers, uye kuchinjanisa kurongeka kwemitsara miviri ye quadratic (semuenzaniso, kuchinjanisa a, b ne c, d) kunoverengwa sekuparadzanisa kumwechete. Mushure mekupedza kugadzirisa, Jiho akati, "Pane kuparadzanisa kumwe chete kwakadaro." Pazasi pane kugadzirisa kwaJiho. (Maitiro ekuverenga: x⁴ i "x to the fourth power", x² i "x squared", uye ac i "a times c".)
z-m-21-01.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakasiyana iwe pachako inoparadza mhedziso
z-m-21-01.thinking.2: Kutonga kuti mhedziso inochinja sei kana mamiriro akachinjwa (integers kuita real numbers)
z-m-21-01.prereq.0: Kuwedzera zvigadzirwa zvemitsara miviri ye quadratic nekurongedza mazwi e degree imwechete (padanho re polynomial unit muCommon Math, giredhi re3 repakati kusvika giredhi re1 repamusoro)
z-m-21-01.prereq.1: Zvinoreva ma polynomials maviri kuva mutsara mumwechete mu x (identity). Giredhi reuku kushanda i musiyano wekuoma chete mukati mebatch yekugadzira uye haisi giredhi rakapiwa mu curriculum
z-m-21-01.prereq.2: Ruzivo rwekuwedzera zvigadzirwa zvemitsara ye linear sa (x−1), (x+1)
z-m-21-01.s.s1.prompt: Mutsetse upi unoita kuti mhedziso yaJiho "imwe chete" iome kuvimba nayo sezvainoita? Sarudza mutsetse mumwe.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.0: Maka kana mutsetse wega wega unotevera zvakananga kubva pamutsetse uri pamberi pawo, uye kubva pamutsetse upi mutsara "iyi ndiyo imwe chete" unotanga kuoneka.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.hint.1: Pamutsetse unogadzira rondedzero ne "i imwe ye ~", sa mutsetse 4, gadzira patsva rondedzero iwe pachako pasi pemamiriro akafanana uye uienzanise imwe neimwe nerondedzero yakanyorwa mumutsetse.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.0: Wedzera (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d) uye uenzanise coefficient yedegree imwe neimwe kuti ive mutsara mumwechete ne x⁴−5x²+4.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.1: Kubva pa coefficient ye x³, a+c=0, saka c=−a, uye kubva pa coefficient ye x, ad+bc=a(d−b)=0, saka a=0 kana b=d.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.3: b ne d i integers uye product yavo i 4, saka (b, d) i imwe ye (1, 4), (4, 1), (2, 2).
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.4: Pakati peizvi, yega inogutsa coefficient ye x² b+d−a²=−5 i b=d=2, a=3 (kana a=−3).
z-m-21-01.s.s1.line.5: Saka, (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2) ndiko kuparadzanisa kumwe chete kwakadaro.
z-m-21-01.s.s1.explain: Kuverenga kwemitsetse 1 kusvika ku 3 kwakarurama (coefficient ye x² i b+d+ac, uye sezvo c=−a, i b+d−a²). Mutsetse 4 ndipo panotanga kukanganisa. Mapeya e integer ane product 4 anosanganisira (−1, −4), (−4, −1), (−2, −2), asi mapeya e positive chete ndiwo akanyorwa. Mutsetse 5 wakarurama "mukati merondedzero yakanyorwa", asi rondedzero haina kukwana, saka "imwe chete" mumutsetse 6 haina rutsigiro. Kunyangwe ukasarudza mutsetse 6, dambudziko harisi kuverenga kwemutsetse iwoyo asi "kuti zviitiko zvese zvakatarisirwa here pakutanga".
z-m-21-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira kuparadzanisa kuviri kwakasiyana (x²+ax+b)(x²+cx+d) kunoenzana ne x⁴−5x²+4. (a, b, c, d i integers. Zvakasiyana nekurongeka chete zvinoverengwa sekuparadzanisa kumwechete.)
z-m-21-01.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzira patsva rondedzero yemitengo ye b, d mukugadzirisa kwaJiho iwe pachako, uye uise mapeya asiri murondedzero mumamiriro e coefficient asara kuti utarise.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.hint.1: Patsanura kuita matavi maviri, chiitiko a=0 nechiitiko b=d, uye utsvage mitengo ye b ne d mune rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.ok.c0: a, b, c, d dzose i integers.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c0: Ndapota ita a, b, c, d integers.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Coefficient ye x³ (a+c) mushure mekuwedzera haisi 0.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Coefficient ye x² (b+d+ac) mushure mekuwedzera haisi −5.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Coefficient ye x (ad+bc) mushure mekuwedzera haisi 0.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.explain: Pane kuparadzanisa kwe integer kutatu kunogoneka: (x²−1)(x²−4), (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2), ne (x²+x−2)(x²−x−2). Kuparadzanisa kwaJiho i kumwe chete kwavo. Zvakasiyana nekurongeka chete, sa kuchinjanisa a ne −a, zvakaverengwa sekuparadzanisa kumwechete.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Kana mapoka maviri akasiyana ose achiita x⁴−5x²+4, mhedziso yaJiho "imwe chete" yakakanganisa kupi? Nyora mitsetse miviri kana mitatu, uchishandisa mutsara mumwe kana kupfuura wawangogadzira.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Wedzera rimwe nerimwe remapoka maviri awakagadzira uye uenzanise kana mhedzisiro i mutsara mumwechete.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti Jiho akarongedza sei zviitiko zvinogoneka uye kana mapoka awakagadzira ari murondedzero iyoyo.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa iwe pachako kuti mutsara wawakapa unova x⁴−5x²+4 kana wawedzerwa here?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura chikonzero chekukanganisa se "kusiya zviitiko zvinogoneka" panzvimbo ye "kukanganisa kuverenga" here?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakanyorawo kuti chii chinofanira kuitwa kuti utaure "imwe chete" here?
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Kuwedzera (x²−1)(x²−4) kunopa x⁴−5x²+4, uye kuwedzera (x²+3x+2)(x²−3x+2) kunopawo mutsara mumwechete. Mapoka ese maviri akarurama, saka haisi imwe chete. Jiho akasiya mapeya akaipa pakati pemapeya e integer ane product 4, saka imwe chete ndiyo yakasara.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.0: Inotaura counterexample (rimwe boka) nechikonzero (kusiya zviitiko) zvose
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.model.1: x⁴−5x²+4 inogona kunyorwa se (x−1)(x+1)(x−2)(x+2), saka zvichienderana nekuti unoaunganidza sei mitsara mina ye linear mumapeya, zvigadzirwa zvakawanda zvemitsara ye quadratic zvinobuda, sa (x²+x−2)(x²−x−2). Mhedziso yaJiho inobva mukuwana nzira imwe chete usina kutarisa zviitiko zvese.
z-m-21-01.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Yakatsanangurwa kubva kumaonero akasiyana, kuunganidza mitsara ye linear
z-m-21-01.s.s3.prompt: Zvino ngatiwedzerei mamiriro e "integer coefficients" kuita "real coefficients" (mitsara miviri ye quadratic ine coefficient ye x² i 1; zvakasiyana nekurongeka chete zvakafanana kuparadzanisa). Mamiriro e coefficient ari pamusoro, a+c=0, a(d−b)=0, b+d−a²=−5, bd=4, anogona kushandiswa sezvaakaita. Chirevo chakakodzera zvikuru nezvenhamba yekuparadzanisa kunogoneka mukuita kwakadaro i chipi?
z-m-21-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga kubva pa a(d−b)=0, patsanura kuita chiitiko a=0 nechiitiko b=d, uye unyore ma equations anosara mune rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.hint.1: Muchikamu chimwe nechimwe, gadzirisa zvakananga uye uverenge kuti b ne d zvinogona kutora makosha mangani kana ari real numbers.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.a: Ma real numbers akawanda zvikuru kupfuura ma integers, saka pane kupatsanura kusingaperi
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.a: Kufunga uku kunoona kuti kana nhamba dzinobvumirwa dzichiwedzera, mhinduro dzinowedzerawo. Asi munyaya ino, ko kutanga wafunga kuti mamiriro e coefficients anosunga sei a, b, c, d pamwe chete?
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.b: Chiri zvitatu. Muzvikamu zviviri (kana a=0 uye kana b=d), makosha atotarwa
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakaparadzanisa kuita zvikamu zviviri uye kwakatarisa kana makosha akatarwa mu real numbers zvakare.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.c: Inodzikira zvichienzaniswa nema integers. Ma real numbers anosanganisira ma integers, saka mamiriro akaoma
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.c: Wakatora mhedziso yakapesana kubva pachokwadi chekuti "ma real numbers anosanganisira ma integers." Kana renji rinobvumirwa rafara, kupatsanura kunogoneka hakugoni kudzikira. Tarisa kana zvitatu zvenyaya ye integer zvichishanda.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.o.d: Mamiriro haakwani, saka hatigoni kutaura kuti pane zvingani
z-m-21-01.s.s3.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoti "ruzivo haruna kukwana" pasina kuverenga kana ma equations mana akapiwa akakwana. Tarisa kana unknowns ina nema equations mana zvichidzikisa makosha.
z-m-21-01.s.s3.explain: Sezvo a(d−b)=0, a=0 kana b=d. Kana a=0, saka b+d=−5 uye bd=4, saka b ne d ndidzo mhinduro mbiri chete −1 ne−4 dze t²+5t+4=0. Kana b=d, saka b²=4 inopa b=±2, uye a²=2b+5, saka kana b=2, a=±3, uye kana b=−2, a=±1. Kunyange mu real numbers hapana chiri kunze kwezvikamu izvi, saka tichifuratira kurongeka pachine zvitatu. Mamiriro ekuva integer haana kuita basa rekusefa munyaya ino.
